claim: Milestone 2A frozen adversarial-evaluation protocol: untargeted cross-entropy FGSM and PGD in MinMax-scaled feature space. These are feature-space attacks; there is no guarantee that perturbed vectors correspond to valid network traffic. Pilot results are non-scientific development checks (1 seed, 2 epochs, small subsets, validation data only) and carry no accuracy or robustness conclusion.
space: MinMax-scaled feature space (fraction of each feature's training range), L-infinity
perturbation_structure: one 39-d delta per example broadcast to all 50 synthetic positions (RowTiedModel); the inherited per-position mode is a labelled sensitivity check only
feasible_set_policy: lower = max(x - eps, min(0, x)); upper = min(x + eps, max(1, x)); clean inputs are never clipped, dropped or skipped and epsilon is never enlarged; out-of-range coordinates may only move toward the interior within [x - eps, x] (or [x, x + eps])

e4.rule: n_extra <= ceil(0.01 * n_subset) in every one of the 12 paired cells
e4.m2a_scope: plumbing only; adequacy is decided in campaign step 0

sources.fp32_direct: gradient from the FP32 model, evaluated on the same FP32 model (white-box)
sources.transfer_fp32_to_int8: pure transfer: FP32 parent ranks and retains candidates (selector None); the retained x_adv is evaluated once on the real INT8 target
sources.transfer_fp32_to_int8_targetsel: gradient from the FP32 parent; candidates selected by queries to the real INT8 target (query-assisted, not a pure transfer)
sources.bpda_int8: forward through the real INT8 target, backward through dequantized weights (approximate gradient, disclosed); selector is CheckedPair
sources.surrogate_fakequant: gradient from a fake-quantized surrogate of the parent; surrogate retains candidates; retained x_adv evaluated once on the real INT8 target
sources.surrogate_fakequant_targetsel: same surrogate; the real INT8 target selects candidates (query-assisted)
sources.direct_int8_grad: diagnostic only: autograd through the converted quantized modules; never reported as robustness

surrogate.construction: prepare_static(qat=True); eval(); enable_observer + enable_fake_quant; calibration rows in saved order under no_grad; disable_observer; no fine-tuning

seed_rule: derived_seed('atk-eval', train_seed, model_id, source, epsilon, batch_index)

evaluation.clean_predictions: one explicit selector (or target) call per batch outside attack()
